The '''Rseik sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. Law in the sector was enforced by the [[Rseikharhl]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who used [[LE-VO law enforcement droid]]s.

==History==
By the time of the [[Bordal Contagion]] of [[214 BBY]], the Rseik sector was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However the Republic authority had ceased to exist beyond [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]] and the Rseik and neighboring [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] had fallen into anarchy. The region had become a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] heaven and [[Planetary Security Forces]] were outgunned by them.<ref name="EGW-cut6" />

But following the Bordal Contagion, various organizations in both sectors, including the [[Ma'ar Shaddam Weaponsmiths Guild]], [[Kett Shipping]], [[Rseikharhl Hullspace]] and [[Cotellieri Transports Limited]] decided to arrange a meeting with a representative from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. After a single [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of meeting on [[Syned]], the organizations agreed to become members of the Federation. Shortly afterward, [[Warship/Legends|warships]] from the [[Trade Defense Force]] overwhelmed the pirates in the area. Eventually the Trade Federation took control over the entire Rseik and Tamarin sectors.<ref name="EGW-cut6" />
